summary: Guests Erik and André from Moosiga Tankar discuss their value investing approach, OnePage analysis format, and case study of Peers Group - a turnaround e-commerce company they own with 70% upside. Host Fredrik analyzes BTS, a management consultant facing North American challenges but showing AI-driven efficiency improvements; he took a small position and expects buying opportunity around Q4-Q1 2026 turnaround signals.
key_takeaways: Moosiga Tankar uses OnePage format combining SWOT, ownership, and financial analysis with 2-year target prices
Peers Group: turnaround play with new management, IT transformation completion expected to boost profitability
BTS: North American turnaround delayed until H1 2026, but AI initiatives showing 10% revenue-per-employee improvement
Value investors looking for quality balance sheets, turnaround potential, and margin of safety (mos)
Active AI investment in consulting sector viewed positively as efficiency driver rather than job threat
